title: TEAMS success - Setting up the Environmental Management Center in Serbia
reference: Ana Popović (Ed.): TEAMS success - Setting up the Environmental Management Center in Serbia. The Regional Environmental Center for Central and Eastern Europe. 58 pp.
authors: Ana Popović (Ed.), Tor Aamodt, Biljana Kotanjac, Radoje Laušević, Damir Oravec, Jovan Pavlović, Jelena Tripković, Vesna Žikić
publisher: The Regional Environmental Center for Central and Eastern Europe
description: This publication was developed in spring 2013 to present the overall activities and results of the project “Setting up the Environmental Management Center (EMC) in Serbia” (SRB-10/0124), funded by the Royal Norwegian Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The main objective of the project was the establishment of the EMC in Serbia for efficient emissions monitoring and reporting within the Serbian Environmental Protection Agency (SEPA), connecting the business sector, environmental authorities and relevant EU institutions.
